acceptance.missing_requirement: Predict a second frozen depth and compare it with measured service at the exact batch-32, remote-KV-2000 shape.
acceptance.registry_movement: Land the single-depth separated derivation and move the eight-layer held-out measurement into the resumable COMP-72 Merlin remainder.

classification.ambiguous_fixed_component_rule: Do not place it in F. Leave it in the four-layer repeatable basis and report that the retained record does not prove it is per-step fixed.
classification.fixed_component_rule: Count fixed_overhead_ps times launch_count in F only when coverage is complete-kernel-stream, kernel_id is aggregate_noncollective_step_service, launch_count is one, and the recorded method identifies retained additive noncollective service.
rejected_as_fixed: fixed_overhead_ps without an explicit whole-step aggregate identity

comparison_context.role: comparison only; it is not an input to either extrapolation

deferred_merlin.resume_rule: After the maintenance gate, submit base then decode under the existing COMP-72 freeze. Preserve every digest-complete output and stop cleanly on SSH loss.

evidence_class.description: DECLARED derivation from a MEASURED decomposition at one depth

hypothesis.expected_direction: strictly smaller when F is positive; unchanged when F is zero
hypothesis.mechanism: The linear rule multiplies each per-step fixed component by 15.25 even though it occurs once per decode step.
hypothesis.separated_rule: T_separated(61) = F + 61 * p where T(4) = F + 4 * p

invalid_if: the target entry identity or exact shape differs
the entry is not MEASURED service with a DISCLOSED component decomposition
the selected entry contains more than one kernel
the aggregate kernel is not an explicit one-launch whole-step record
the component reconstruction differs from measured_service_ps
the published throughput value enters selection, classification, or arithmetic
any retained record is read as a whole
rounding: Round nonnegative rational picoseconds half up only at the published step boundary.
